macro_evidence.title: Anthropic said to target mega-IPO before thanksgiving holiday
affected_inputs: competition for AI talent and customers
macro_evidence.reason: A prospective Anthropic mega-IPO (reported mid-November target) is likely to refocus investor attention and capital on AI-related assets in the near term. That can boost sentiment and demand for large, AI-exposed communication services firms, supporting short-term risk appetite and multiple expansion for names like Meta. Secondary effects: increased visibility for AI could spur short-term incremental flows into big tech; downside risk from longer-term competition for AI talent/customers is more structural and less likely to be the dominant market reaction over the next 1–15 trading days.
